name: B23M
summary: B23M is a Leadshine standard split optical encoder family using a reflective sensing design. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

description.en: B23M is a Leadshine standard split optical encoder family using a reflective sensing design. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

sources.title: 雷赛智能-分体光电系列
sources.quote: B23M系列光编码器有以下特点： 1、超薄14.9mm 2、重复定位精度＜±5角秒 3、RS485接口，多种通信速率兼容 4、单圈23位，多圈16位 5、通信线缆最长可达50m 6、严苛EMC测试，满足恶劣电磁环境工况 产品优势
